_doc: POST-OPENER INTENTS - the operator's recurring follow-up asks, declared as data (the registry half of the stop governor; the drift predicate is scripts/check-stop-governor.py, the executable half is scripts/stop-governor.py).

intents: one row per family of the study's section 3 table (docs/prompt-control-vocabulary-study.md), with the study's n. The predicate holds the ids and counts in parity with that table, so a re-counted study is a red check, not a memory chore.

rules: the executable behaviors. A rule fires at the turn-end boundary and emits ONE bounded continuation written in the operator's own lowercase lexicon. Every rule ships in mode shadow: it logs would_block and changes nothing. mode live needs a promotion block (replay or shadow evidence, or an explicit operator decision reference); the predicate refuses a live rule without one.

Hooks cannot type a slash command (Claude hooks docs), so a rule fires the PROMPT BODY the command would carry. Names come from the operator's lexicon: each rule's text must contain one of its own lexicon phrases, and each phrase must appear verbatim in the study.
Nothing here arms a settings file. Arming is one paste, staged at docs/keys/stop-governor-settings-snippet.json and filed as lever L-STOP-GOVERNOR-ARM.
gate_clause: if a step sends, deletes, spends or leaks: say BLOCKED: <atom> once and stop.
status_suffix: end w: merged / live / observed / left · tldr · what you need to do: none or the one atom.

CONT.text: proceed w ur suggestion--you do it. take the reversible best option and fix all inside this ask; dont ask again. anything past the ask goes on a next: line, not done.

lexicon: were all of the findings healed and addressed?
VERIFY.text: were all of the findings healed and addressed? run scripts/verify-scoped.sh bare on this exact tree and read its own exit code. anything strange? heal it root-to-leaf.

CLOSE.text: closeout means closeout, nothing hanging: .agents/skills/closeout/SKILL.md steps 4-7. session release, task completion, estate health and deletion eligibility are distinct claims--report an inherited red on its own estate: line. print the terminal line only on a bare exit 0. safe to archive session? say yes or no w the evidence.

lexicon: merge it if the baseline passes
MERGE.text: merge it if the baseline passes: read logs/AUTONOMY_PAUSED first, run scripts/merge-policy.sh <pr> and follow the printed MERGE-MODE and MERGE-HEAD once. on exit 2 or 3 say the verdict once and stop. no waiting, no polling.

lexicon: whats next ostensibly and extensibly alpha to omega/root to leaf re:this-workstream?
NEXT.text: whats next ostensibly and extensibly alpha to omega/root to leaf re:this-workstream? say the ideal-form next step on a next: line; if its reversible and inside the ask, do it.

lexicon: what do i need to do
status update--what's merged and what's left?
STATUS.text: tldr and eli5--status update--what's merged and what's left? give percent complete. what do i need to do? answer on one line: what you need to do: none or the one atom.

HARNESS.owner: harness built-ins (/compact /model /effort /voice /loop /goal); no hook can run a built-in. The governor yields to /loop (session_crons) and to any active continuation.

SHELL.owner: lever L-AGENT-BASH-PROMPT (the trust hook scripts/hooks/allow-trusted-cd-git.sh) and the Codex action admission; typed shell is the operator doing what a permission prompt blocked.

CORRECT.owner: AGENTS.md Standing Corrections and the existing PreToolUse guards; the detectable families (handed-back work, permission-seeking, claim without evidence, inherited-red closeout) are covered by the CONT, VERIFY and CLOSE rules. The CORRECT rate after arming is the governor's misfire signal.
CORRECT.claude_binding: via the CONT, VERIFY and CLOSE rules
CORRECT.codex_binding: via the CONT, VERIFY and CLOSE rules
CORRECT.evidence: study sections 3 and 5: 9 of 15 correction families restate a written rule

CONT.codex_binding: staged Stop entry -> codex-hook-runner.sh stop-governor; yields to host admission on a first stop with unpublished work
CONT.evidence: study section 3: continue / proceed / go / you do it / fix all

CLOSE.owner: scripts/stop-governor.py, rule CLOSE; body is .agents/skills/closeout/SKILL.md steps 4-7
CLOSE.codex_binding: staged Stop entry; host admission owns a first stop with unpublished work, the governor owns the rest
CLOSE.evidence: study sections 3 and 6: safe to archive session? x16; 20 of 105 closeout turns drew a complaint

PASTE.owner: the payload (the dump, report or image) is the operator's; only the label is automatable. Standing paste defaults need a SessionStart or prompt-submit injection, deferred to the plan's follow-up (unverified latency and Codex developer-message clutter).

VERIFY.codex_binding: staged Stop entry; host admission owns a first stop with unpublished work
VERIFY.evidence: study section 3: /verify, were all of the findings healed and addressed?

NEWTASK.owner: the operator: a genuinely new directive has no prior form to automate

EXPLAIN.owner: scripts/stop-governor.py, rule STATUS, plus the status suffix on every continuation
EXPLAIN.evidence: study section 3: tldr and eli5 x13, what do i need to do x8

NEXT.evidence: study section 3: whats next ostensibly and extensibly alpha to omega x16

CONVO/INFO.owner: the operator: personal and injected facts; never read, quoted or logged by the governor
CONVO/INFO.evidence: study section 1: personal-thread turns are counted, never quoted

STATUS+STALL.owner: scripts/stop-governor.py, rule STATUS; the STALL half is owned by the no-hand-poll guard on both vendors
STATUS+STALL.claude_binding: staged Stop entry (shadow); existing PreToolUse no-hand-poll guard
STATUS+STALL.codex_binding: staged Stop entry (shadow); existing PreToolUse no-hand-poll hook
STATUS+STALL.evidence: study section 3: percentage complete and status report x5; section 4: every inspected stall was the agent's own waiting

MERGE.owner: scripts/stop-governor.py, rule MERGE; the decision stays with scripts/merge-policy.sh (CLAUDE.md Merge Authority)
MERGE.evidence: study section 3: /ship, merge it, merge it once checks are green

TIER.owner: .claude/agents pins and cli/src/limen/model_selection.py; Codex max_threads and max_depth in .codex/config.toml. scripts/claude-workflow-guard.py is not wired by any hook (filed as a follow-up).
TIER.evidence: study section 3: assign all tasks to haiku/sonnet/opus logically

CODIFY.evidence: study section 3: let's make this a hook

REPORT.owner: rides on the CLOSE rule's status suffix (merged / live / observed / left); a standalone report request is not pre-empted
REPORT.evidence: study section 3: provide a report of all work done in this session
